---

## Purpose & Context
The workshop relies heavily on high-contrast visual cues to pace the 75-minute instructional schedule. The slide deck anchors the opening 20-second John Doe critique, visualizes the 3-Question Test, presents the bullet formula, introduces the 8 core LaTeX commands, and displays the Google AI Studio master prompt.

---

## Exact Scope
### In Scope
- Create a complete presentation deck matching the 17-slide structure detailed in [`slides/README.md`](file:///d:/Resume%20building%20event/slides/README.md).
- Embed high-resolution visual of `John_Doe_Resume.pdf` for the opening diagnostic challenge.
- Display the exact Bullet Formula: `Action + What + How/Tech + Result/Outcome`.
- Display the 8 core LaTeX commands and character escaping rules.
- Display the verbatim Google AI Studio copy-paste prompt.
- Incorporate time cues matching the 75-minute schedule.

### Out of Scope
- Adding supplementary topics (e.g. Git branching, cover letters, LinkedIn networking) that displace core resume content.
- Visual animations that distract from text legibility.

---

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Contains all 17 slides specified in `slides/README.md`.
- [ ] Every slide includes facilitator notes and time allocations matching the Facilitator Guide.
- [ ] Text is legible at 1080p from 15 meters away (minimum 24pt headers, 18pt body).
- [ ] Zero fabrication rule is prominent on AI Studio slides.
- [ ] QR code / shortened links included for Overleaf template and AI Studio.
- [ ] Slide platform conforms to decision in `docs/decisions.md` (DEC-OPEN-01).
